title: Romance with
my donut.
caption: February 14. The pink one got the seat at the table. No regrets, no notes.

title: Behind the
red.
caption: Fabric pulled across the lens. A face beneath that doesn’t quite need to be seen — and that, I think, is the point.

title: Self-portrait,
in the dunes.
caption: A knit sweater laid across sand that has been here longer than language. Loonse en Drunense Duinen, on a quiet afternoon.

title: A quiet
afternoon.
caption: Black and white, a wooden fence, an embroidered dress. A few minutes that turned into a small series and then into a longer thought.
